title: AI in Radiology: From Innovation to Clinical Practice
location: UBC Medical Student & Alumni Centre (MSAC), 2750 Heather Street
description: Short talks from radiology and AI researchers and clinicians, including Dr. Ricky Hu, Dr. Fereshteh Yousefirizi, Dr. Ian Alberts, and more, followed by a panel and audience questions.

title: AI in Medicine Lunch & Learn
speaker: Dr. Hashim Kareemi
description: An AI education session for medical students exploring applications of AI in emergency medicine and healthcare.

title: National Health Datathon 2026
description: A two-day national datathon on data science and AI for real-world healthcare challenges, hosted at UBC by the UBC Data Science and Health (DASH) Research Cluster, UBC Department of Computer Science, UBC MedData Research Society and UBC AIMS, and led nationally by T-CAIREM at the University of Toronto. It brought together 161 students from across Canada, 70 of them from BC.

title: AI in Health Datathon 2027
description: National student datathon on AI in healthcare, building on the 2026 datathon.

title: AI & the Future of Medicine Symposium
description: A cross-disciplinary symposium on improving health with AI implemented safely, ethically and responsibly, with expert panels, hands-on workshops and keynotes by Dr. Danièle Behn Smith and Dr. Leo Celi.

title: UBC AIMS launches
description: UBC AIMS started as a student-led group exploring the role of AI in healthcare through workshops, expert panels and discussions.

title: MedData Datathon 2026
description: Student health datathon held in March 2026.
